surface_interpolation: Upper and lower depth surfaces affine in longitude and latitude with a bilinear cross term over each matched rectangle. The unsampled interior is explicitly assumed, not measured or newly resolved by the model.
volume_operator: Integrate bilinear thickness over spherical surface area,with analytic cos(latitude) weights;6371008.8m sphere and constant-surface-footprint vertical extrusion. No radial-shell correction. Convert m3 to km3.
sampling_scenarios: Original corner crossing-bracket thickness scenarios propagated through the same positive integration weights;not physical uncertainty,confidence intervals,true-volume guarantees or seasonal extrema.
interpretation: Partial signed-component regional reference-geometry scenarios at the source0.1m/s cutoff. Four-corner matches do not establish water-mass identity,an axis,interior topography or whole-current extent. Unknown cells remain gaps;no annual/current/global sum.
